$comment: REQ-BLD-001/002/003. Source weights are the §16 ratios verbatim. Equipment and cards are weighted here even though Phase 1 supplies null contributions (DL-009) so Phase 2 needs no reweighting.

attributeRoleAffinity.$comment: How each attribute pushes the role lean. Read by BuildIdentity, never hardcoded.

riskPosture.$comment: 0 = maximally cautious, 1 = maximally aggressive. Base 0.5, shifted by the listed sources, then clamped.

fromAttributeRatio.$comment: Offensive attributes push aggressive, defensive attributes push cautious.

resourceProfile.$comment: 0 = burst (few expensive decisive actions), 1 = sustain (many cheap actions). Derived from the cost and cooldown shape of the active loadout.

versatility.$comment: Breadth of known-but-unequipped skills. This is the Skill Books contribution (§16) and is what makes a well-read hunter distinct from a narrow specialist.

confidence.$comment: How sharply defined the identity is. A hunter with a flat role lean is a generalist; one with a dominant lean is a specialist. Used by the AI to decide how strictly to hold to build identity (REQ-BLD-004).
